judge.rationale: Roughly three-quarters or more of the primary molecular explanation is shared—FXYD6 regulation of Na+/K+-ATPase in a CNR1-high/HTR3A-high, CORO6-low/FLT3-low CGE-like state—while unique additions such as CCK identity, HTR3A-driven Na+ loading, CNR1–cAMP/PKA signaling, FXYD1 analogy, and stronger CORO6/FLT3 mechanistic claims prevent near-complete agreement.
